title: Farm Robotics Challenge 2027
summary: Develop agricultural robotics, sensing, AI, control or automation with an adviser-backed team.
eligibility: Global university / technical-school students. Excluded institutional affiliations apply; graduate members at most 50%.

prize.description: University Division I cash: US$25,000 / 10,000 / 5,000, paid through the institution or adviser.

notes: US$100/team entry fee; teams fund equipment. Member-count limit was not established.
Final video / report due 2 May 2027; virtual awards in June.
The US$200,000+ headline includes startup support and other benefits.
